marc:datafield.marc:subfield: MAC and Ted is an educational 3D animation series that tells the adventures of a cute little robot named MAC who lives with Ted's family on earth. MAC accidentally crashes his spaceship at Ted's backyard and immediately captures the family's heart with his cute and fun personality. MAC has much to learn about his new home, which he finds out is called Earth.Children will learn along with MAC in a fun and happy way. The character design reflects the fun and cute concept with cuddly, cute and adorable characters. Mac and Ted is an animation suitable for children and the entire family to enjoy with sing-along songs and fun story lines for the family to enjoy.
